blogPosts.title: How Much Does Custom Kitchen Cabinetry Cost in Cheltenham?

body: When considering custom kitchen cabinetry in Cheltenham, the cost can vary significantly based on several factors. The average cost in Melbourne's southeastern suburbs like Cheltenham typically starts from $8,000 for a basic setup but can exceed $20,000 for high-end designs with premium materials.

Key cost drivers include the choice of timber, such as Victorian ash or imported hardwoods, which affect durability and price. In Cheltenham, where coastal humidity can impact materials, we recommend moisture-resistant finishes. Labour costs in Cheltenham are competitive, with skilled carpenters earning around $60-$80 per hour. At Armstrongs, we handle everything in-house, from our local workshop to installation, minimizing overheads and passing savings to customers. For a typical Cheltenham kitchen, expect 60% of the cost to go towards materials and 40% towards labour, ensuring you get value without compromising on quality.

Australian building standards, such as AS/NZS 4266 for cabinetry, must be adhered to, and at Armstrongs, we ensure all our Cheltenham projects comply. This includes using FSC-certified timbers and low-VOC finishes for a healthy home environment. To get an accurate estimate for your Cheltenham kitchen, we offer free on-site consultations where we assess your space, discuss your vision, and provide a fixed quote. Factors like the size of the kitchen, whether it's an L-shape or U-shape layout, and additional features like breakfast bars or wine coolers will be evaluated. Investing in custom cabinetry from Armstrongs in Cheltenham is a long-term decision. With proper care, our kitchens can last 20-30 years, enhancing your home's value and daily enjoyment. blogPosts.title: Caring for Your Timber Cabinetry in Cheltenham's Climate
blogPosts.excerpt: Tips on maintaining custom cabinetry in Cheltenham's varying climate, from humidity control to regular upkeep.
body: Cheltenham's climate, with its coastal humidity and temperature swings, requires special care for timber cabinetry. At Armstrongs, we've crafted durable pieces for Cheltenham homes for 45 years, and we advise customers on maintenance to extend lifespan. Regular dusting and avoiding direct sunlight exposure prevent fading and warping in Cheltenham's variable conditions.

Humidity control is crucial in Cheltenham, especially during humid summers. Use dehumidifiers or air conditioning to keep indoor levels between 30-50%, preventing timber expansion. For kitchen and bathroom cabinetry, ensure proper ventilation with extractor fans to reduce moisture buildup, a common issue in Cheltenham's older homes.

Cleaning routines should be gentle. Wipe Cheltenham cabinetry with a soft, damp cloth and mild soap, avoiding abrasive cleaners that damage finishes. For timber surfaces, apply a protective polish annually. Armstrongs recommends using products compatible with the original finish used in your Cheltenham installation to maintain consistency.

Inspect regularly for signs of wear. In Cheltenham's climate, check for loose hinges, swollen doors, or finish cracks, especially in high-moisture areas. Early detection allows for simple fixes, like tightening screws or reapplying sealant, preventing costly repairs. Armstrongs offers maintenance checks for Cheltenham customers as part of our aftercare service.

Seasonal adjustments can help. During Cheltenham's colder months, use humidifiers to counter dryness from heating systems, preventing timber cracking. In summer, keep cabinetry away from direct airflow from air conditioners to avoid rapid temperature changes. This proactive approach preserves the integrity of your Armstrongs cabinetry in Cheltenham.

Long-term care includes avoiding heavy impacts and using coasters for hot items. For Cheltenham families with children, teach gentle handling to prevent dents. Armstrongs provides Cheltenham customers with a care guide upon installation, ensuring you have all the tips to keep your cabinetry looking new for decades.
